business_summary: Kyosan Electric Manufacturing Co., Ltd. provides railway signaling and traffic management solutions in Japan, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Signal Systems Business and Power Electronics Business. It offers railway signaling solutions, including train control and detection equipment, interlocking equipment, block systems, field equipment, level crossing control equipment, total traffic control systems, maintenance equipment, power supply for signaling systems, and railway-related equipment. The company also provides safeguards for passenger transfer areas, such as partial-height platform screen doors, gap fillers, falling detection devices, and warning devices; passenger information display devices and funeral hall display systems; and traffic management solutions comprising road traffic control systems, road traffic signal controllers, road traffic signal units, traffic sensors, information displays, additional devices, transmission systems, and disaster prevention products. In addition, it offers power electronics solutions consisting of digitally controlled RF systems and DC converters; uninterruptible power supplies for signal; and power supplies for industrial equipment. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
